PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Visual Programming, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming.
